notes.title: More quality of life/balance changes to Clawdina
notes.notes:
Less attacks required for each phase of Clawdina

Phase 1: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 2 from 4
Phase 2: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 3 from 4
Phase 3: Reduced attacks needed till signature to 6 from 7

Clawdina won't repeat the same attack in a row anymore

Added slightly more time between attacks in phase 3

Whack attack has less chance to spawn an addition claw

Overall the boss should still be a big challenge but more fair to learn and less of a slog once you learn phase 1 and 2

notes.title: Clawdina Boss Fight Fixes/Small Changes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038090/71a49b11fae0117afbb114fdeceb6a3cfaa32f0d.png

-Clawdina's attacks are all the same length of time, to lessen the rng a bit and make each attack a threat but not a bore.

-Reduced the collision hitbox size of the claw to make it more fair

-Some of Clawdina's attacks were made deadlier in the shorter time they are active, it shouldn't be too much of a difficulty increase but certain attacks that were a long walk in the park have been made more intense

-The spinning claw attack is now more deadlier, possibly spawning an extra claw where you stand as to prevent camping the sides. As well as the current ones possibly spawning at that spot.

-Fixed bug causing your health to not be set back to 3 when reaching the boss again after a restart if your health was less than 3

Overall the fight should be more fun, more intense, but less rng that increased the length of the fight

notes.title: First Big Demo Update v0.3
notes.notes:
Yoyo! A new update is out for the demo build, cleaning up the house and fixing some much needed things


The sound menu now functions properly, saving your sound and setting it once you reopen the game
Player rotation is saved and resets on restart
Lots of places to get stuck are now adjusted
Velocity is reset on restart so you don't go flying if you were falling before restarting
You can jump when really close to objects now, without your jump height being drastically reduced!
Moved grub out of glass jar
Categorized uncategorized sound effects
